entities.name: Phasing of Teferi's Isle
entities.description: Temporal event c. 3995 AR that removed the Chaza Isles from time for two centuries after Teferi's failed experiment.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker from Zhalfir whose failed time experiment phased his isle out of time.

entities.name: Teferi's Isle
entities.description: Secluded enclave for magical research in the Chaza Isles.

entities.name: Chaza Isles
entities.description: Hidden archipelago removed from the flow of time.

entities.name: Yormeba
entities.description: Royal descendant trained by Teferi who became queen.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Sent a dragon to attack the isle after it phased back.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: Bloody war on Jamuraa made possible by Teferi's absence.

events.summary: Teferi trains a royal descendant who becomes Queen Yormeba and brings tenuous peace.
events.quote: She rose to power with his guidance as Queen Yormeba

events.summary: Teferi withdraws and founds Teferi's Isle in the hidden Chaza Isles with his advisors.
Teferi's time experiments begin tearing rents in time.
events.quote: The first experiments tore small rents in time

events.summary: Teferi's mana blast to heal time phases the isle out of existence.
events.quote: The explosion phased the entire island

events.summary: Two centuries later the isle phases back; Teferi learns it was suspended for 200 years amid the Mirage War.
events.quote: Teferi investigated and uncovered the truth

relations.quote: he located and trained a promising royal descendant
